channel.title: The Daily Globe – Daily Briefings
channel.description: Headlines from around the world, updated every few minutes

item.title: How to Start an Online Shop in the UK in 2026: A Beginner's Guide
item.description: A plain-English UK guide to starting an online shop in 2026: HMRC and the £1,000 trading allowance, choosing products, Shopify vs Etsy vs WooCommerce, payments, shipping and marketing.

item.title: Daily World Briefing: Friday 30 October 2026
item.description: The main stories around the world as of Friday 30 October 2026, in our own words from UN News reporting: the Dnipro rail station strike, Sudan, Haiti's hunger crisis, Afghanistan's opium rebound, Myanmar and the vote on the Cuba embargo.

item.title: Ebola in DR Congo passes 10,000 cases: what we know
item.description: The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DR Congo is the country's largest ever. We explain the numbers, the spread to Kenya and the vaccine trial that has just begun.

item.title: Three UN-backed climate reports in one week: what they say before COP31
item.description: Record heat deaths, record greenhouse gases and a weakening ocean carbon sink. A plain-English guide to three new reports released ahead of the COP31 climate conference in Antalya.
